body:
Goal: spec D5 and C30. Edit only AGENTS.md: (a) add a pointer to the docs site $DOCS_URL (the Vercel production URL recorded in spec D8 / website/README.md) and to website/ as the place docs are written; (b) correct the stale @adlc/core / @adlc/antigravity version pins (currently "^1.6.0") to match root package.json; (c) replace the fixed test count with "run npm test and show the output". Proposed wording: (a) after the first paragraph of 'Project-specific facts', add a bullet: "- Published docs: <DOCS_URL> (Vercel) — written in `website/` (Fumadocs). Reference pages are generated; see CONTRIBUTING.md 'Docs generator contract'." (b) replace "`@adlc/core` (`^1.6.0`) and `@adlc/antigravity` (`^1.6.0`) are both real npm registry dependencies" with "`@adlc/core` and `@adlc/antigravity` are both real npm registry dependencies (versions pinned in root `package.json`)" — version-free so it cannot go stale. (c) replace the parenthetical "(496 tests as of 2026-10-05 — check the current count, don't assume it's stale)" with nothing, leaving "Run `npm test` and show the output." Leave other numbers (e.g. adversarial-review rounds) alone. Approval: open the PR as draft containing this diff and ask the owner in a PR comment; approval = an owner PR comment or approving review on that wording; put its URL in the PR description. If the owner asks for changes, apply exactly those; if rejected, close the PR. Edit nothing else; `git diff origin/main -- AGENTS.md` must not touch the 'Security self-attestation' section (check with `git diff -U0 origin/main -- AGENTS.md`). Do not touch the Security self-attestation section's meaning, and never touch .adlc/config.json.

Context: repo antigravity-booster (agb), plugin v1.0.0. Spec: .adlc/specs/docs-site.md (revision 3: Vercel hosting, default Next.js server output) — read it first; section references below point into it. Use Node >= 22.19.0. Work on a branch off origin/main; never push to or merge into main (merge is the owner's decision).

Hard constraints: never modify .adlc/config.json (including acknowledgedNewRailBypass / trustedCodeownersAttested), lib/lock.mjs, lib/gates.mjs or CODEOWNERS (these are this ticket's rails). 

Base / prerequisites: start after T-DOCS-ROOT-SLIM is merged and the Vercel production site at the recorded DOCS_URL returns 200 (AC28). Substitute the literal recorded URL for <DOCS_URL>; never invent it.

Operational notes:
- Run commands from the repo root; lines beginning `cd website &&` run in a subshell, e.g. `(cd website && npm ci)`.
- `npm test` is the required gate. `unshare -r -n npm test` is informational: run it if user namespaces are available and paste the output; if unsupported, say so. `cd website && npm ci` needs network and is not run under unshare.
- `npx adlc` resolves from root node_modules after `npm ci` (offline after install).
- AC30 `gate-manifest record` writes .adlc/manifest.jsonl, which is untracked at 4864376: do not commit it; paste the `verify` output. If record fails for environmental reasons (e.g. missing ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY), paste the error; it is an audit gate and does not block the PR (AGENTS.md degrade rule).
- The follow-up chore PR touches only .adlc/tickets/ and .adlc/ticket-archive/ (ticket complete/archive); it is not part of this ticket's scope.

Verification (run each, show output in the PR description):
- npm test (root suite passes; spec AC1, also try: unshare -r -n npm test)
- git diff --quiet origin/main -- .adlc/config.json; echo $?   -> 0 (AC29)
- npx adlc rails-guard --base origin/main --rails lib/lock.mjs --rails lib/gates.mjs --rails .adlc/config.json --rails CODEOWNERS; echo $?   -> 0 (AC22)
- npm test && npx adlc gate-manifest record tests --ticket T-DOCS-AGENTS-MD && npx adlc gate-manifest verify; echo $?   -> 0 (AC30)

- git diff --stat origin/main   -> only AGENTS.md changed
- grep -cE "[0-9]{3,} tests" AGENTS.md   -> 0
- grep -cF "$DOCS_URL" AGENTS.md   -> >= 1; grep -c "github.io/antigravity-booster" AGENTS.md   -> 0

Finish: open a PR (not merged by you). After merge, in a follow-up chore PR, run npx adlc ticket complete T-DOCS-AGENTS-MD --write --authorize then npx adlc ticket archive T-DOCS-AGENTS-MD --write --authorize (AC31). Archive this ticket after merge.
title: Update AGENTS.md with owner-approved wording for the docs site
